newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Normandy acquiring 100 percent of lead/copper mine.
newsitem.headline: Normandy acquiring 100 percent of lead/copper mine.

text.p: Normandy Mining Ltd said on Friday it would increase its ownership of the Scuddles copper and zinc deposit in Western Australia to 100 percent from 65 percent.

An agreement in principle had been reached with Esso Australia Resources Ltd, a unit of Exxon Corp, to acquire Esso's 35 percent stake in the Golden Grove Joint Venture, under which Scuddles is held, Normandy said.
Normandy said the purchase was consistent with its strategy of increasing ownership of operations where it was the manager.
Sole ownerhip offered the opportunity for early development of the nearby Gossan Hill copper, zinc and gold deposit and also oxide gold resources at Minjar, Normandy said.
A purchase price was not disclosed.
